  • Read Authentication to learn how to protect routes
  • See Permissions to learn about access control

docs.title: Data Validation
docs.text: SRF uses Pydantic for data validation and serialization, providing powerful type safety and data validation capabilities. For detailed usage of Pydantic, please refer to the official documentation!

docs.title: Defining a schema
docs.text:
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional


class ProductSchema(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., max_length=100)
    price: float = Field(..., gt=0)
    stock: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    description: Optional[str] = None

docs.title: Using it in a ViewSet
docs.text:
from srf.views import BaseViewSet
from models import Product
from schemas import ProductSchema


class ProductViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    schema = ProductSchema

    @property
    def queryset(self):
        return Product.all()

docs.title: Numeric validation
docs.text:
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class ProductSchema(BaseModel):
    price: float = Field(..., gt=0)           # Greater than 0
    stock: int = Field(..., ge=0)             # Greater than or equal to 0
    discount: float = Field(..., lt=100)      # Less than 100
    rating: int = Field(..., le=5)            # Less than or equal to 5
    quantity: int = Field(..., ge=1, le=1000) # Range: 1-1000

docs.title: String validation
docs.text:
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, EmailStr


class ProductSchema(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=100)
    sku: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^[A-Z]{3}-\d{6}$")
    email: EmailStr  # Email validation

docs.title: Lists and sets
docs.text:
from typing import List, Set
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class ProductSchema(BaseModel):
    tags: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    images: List[str] = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=10)
    categories: Set[int] = Field(default_factory=set)

docs.title: Custom validators
docs.text:
from typing import Optional
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator


class ProductSchema(BaseModel):
    name: str
    price: float
    discount_price: Optional[float] = None

    @field_validator("name")
    @classmethod
    def validate_name(cls, value):
        if not value.strip():
            raise ValueError("Product name cannot be empty")
        return value.strip()

    @field_validator("discount_price")
    @classmethod
    def validate_discount(cls, value, info):
        if value is not None and "price" in info.data:
            if value >= info.data["price"]:
                raise ValueError("The discount price must be less than the original price")
        return value

docs.title: Writer schema (write)
docs.text:
Used for create and update operations:

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class ProductSchemaWriter(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., max_length=100)
    price: float = Field(..., gt=0)
    stock: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    category_id: int

docs.title: Reader schema (read)
docs.text:
Used for serializing returned data:

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, computed_field
from datetime import datetime


class ProductSchemaReader(BaseModel):
    id: int
    name: str
    price: float
    stock: int
    category_id: int
    created_at: datetime

    @computed_field
    @property
    def is_in_stock(self) -> bool:
        return self.stock > 0

    @computed_field
    @property
    def url(self) -> str:
        return f"/api/products/{self.id}"

    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

docs.title: Using it in a ViewSet
docs.text:
BaseViewSet.as_view() sets self.request and self.action before calling the action method, so get_schema() does not need to accept a request parameter. Sanic's request.is_safe is a property that indicates whether the current HTTP method is a safe method; it is suitable for choosing a schema based on read/write requests:

from srf.views import BaseViewSet
from schemas import ProductSchemaReader, ProductSchemaWriter


class ProductViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    def get_schema(self):
        return ProductSchemaReader if self.request.is_safe else ProductSchemaWriter

To choose based on the ViewSet action name — for example, when a custom action needs its own schema — check self.action:

from srf.views import BaseViewSet
from schemas import ProductSchemaReader, ProductSchemaWriter


class ProductViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    def get_schema(self):
        if self.action in ("list", "retrieve"):
            return ProductSchemaReader
        return ProductSchemaWriter

You can also simply fix the schema class attribute as needed:

from srf.views import BaseViewSet
from srf.permission import SafeMethodOnly
from schemas import ProductSchemaReader


class ProductViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    permission_classes = [
        SafeMethodOnly,
    ]
    schema = ProductSchemaReader

is_safe classifies by HTTP method; self.action classifies by the ViewSet method bound to the route. Which one to use depends on the API design. The built-in create / update use the same schema returned by get_schema() to validate input and serialize the response.

strict=True and partial updates

The built-in create / update use schema.model_validate(request.json, strict=True):

  • Strings in the request body are not automatically converted to types such as datetime / date / Decimal; if the write schema contains such fields, clients must send values that pass strict validation (usually you should use str or float fields instead, or override create / update).
  • update validates the request body against the full schema, and PUT and PATCH behave the same; there is currently no true partial update. The request body must satisfy the schema's required fields.

docs.title: Basic types
docs.text:
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import Optional


class ExampleSchema(BaseModel):
    name: str           # String
    age: int            # Integer
    price: float        # Float
    is_active: bool     # Boolean
    description: Optional[str] = None  # Optional

docs.title: Dates and times
docs.text:
from datetime import date, datetime, time


class EventSchema(BaseModel):
    event_date: date         # Date
    created_at: datetime     # Datetime
    start_time: time         # Time

docs.title: Advanced types
docs.text:
from pydantic import EmailStr, HttpUrl
from decimal import Decimal


class AdvancedSchema(BaseModel):
    email: EmailStr       # Email
    website: HttpUrl      # URL
    price: Decimal        # Precise decimal number

docs.title: Enum types
docs.text:
from enum import Enum
from pydantic import BaseModel
from srf.views import BaseViewSet
from models import Product


class ProductStatus(str, Enum):
    DRAFT = "draft"
    PUBLISHED = "published"
    ARCHIVED = "archived"


class ProductSchema(BaseModel):
    name: str
    status: ProductStatus = ProductStatus.DRAFT

docs.title: Validation error responses
docs.text:
When Pydantic validation fails in create / update, as_view() converts it into PydanticValidationException (422). The response body returned by Sanic looks like:

{
  "description": "Unprocessable Entity",
  "status": 422,
  "message": "1 validation error for ProductSchemaWriter\nprice\n  Input should be greater than 0 ..."
}

message is str(ValidationError), not a structured list of fields. If you need per-field errors, register a global exception handler or override create / update and call error.errors() yourself.

docs.title: Complete example
docs.text:
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator, computed_field, ConfigDict
from typing import Optional, List
from datetime import datetime
from enum import Enum
from srf.views import BaseViewSet
from models import Product


class ProductStatus(str, Enum):
    DRAFT = "draft"
    PUBLISHED = "published"


class ProductSchemaWriter(BaseModel):
    """Write schema"""

    name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=200)
    sku: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^[A-Z]{3}-\d{6}$")
    price: float = Field(..., gt=0)
    stock: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    category_id: int
    tags: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    status: ProductStatus = ProductStatus.DRAFT

    @field_validator("name")
    @classmethod
    def validate_name(cls, value):
        if not value.strip():
            raise ValueError("Product name cannot be empty")
        return value.strip()


class ProductSchemaReader(BaseModel):
    """Read schema"""

    id: int
    name: str
    sku: str
    price: float
    stock: int
    category_id: int
    tags: List[str]
    status: ProductStatus
    created_at: datetime

    @computed_field
    @property
    def is_in_stock(self) -> bool:
        return self.stock > 0

    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)


# Using it in a ViewSet
class ProductViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    @property
    def queryset(self):
        return Product.all()

    def get_schema(self):
        # Choose the read/write schema by HTTP method here; see above for the complete selection approach.
        return ProductSchemaReader if self.request.is_safe else ProductSchemaWriter

docs.title: Best practices
docs.text:
1. Use type annotations: provide complete type information
  2. Separate read and write schemas: define different schemas for different operations
  3. Add validation rules: use Field and validators to ensure data validity
  4. Use enums: use enum types for fixed options
  5. Computed fields: use @computed_field to add derived fields
  6. Friendly errors: return clear error messages in validators

docs.title: Next steps
docs.text:
• Study Views to learn how to use schemas in ViewSets
  • Read Authentication to learn about user data validation
  • See Filtering to learn about query parameter validation

docs.title: Social Login
docs.text: SRF supports social login integration and currently supports GitHub OAuth.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: SRF includes GitHub OAuth login. Other identity providers require the application to implement and register the corresponding OAuth flow itself.

docs.title: Advantages
docs.text:
• Good user experience: no extra password to remember
  • Lower registration barrier: one-click login improves conversion
  • High security: leverages the security mechanisms of third-party platforms
  • Automatic data retrieval: basic user information can be obtained

docs.title: 1. Create a GitHub OAuth App
docs.text:
1. Go to GitHub Settings > Developer settings > OAuth Apps
  2. Click "New OAuth App"
  3. Fill in the application information:
  4. Application name: Your App Name
  5. Homepage URL: http://localhost:8000 (development environment)
  6. Authorization callback URL: http://localhost:8000/api/auth/social/callback
  7. Click "Register application"
  8. Note the Client ID and the generated Client Secret

docs.title: 2. Configure environment variables
docs.text:
Add the following to the .env file:

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=your-github-client-id
GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET=your-github-client-secret
GITHUB_REDIRECT_URI=http://localhost:8000/api/auth/social/callback
OAUTH_SUCCESS_REDIRECT_URI=http://localhost:3000/auth/callback
JWT_SECRET=replace-with-a-long-random-secret
SECRET_KEY=replace-with-another-long-random-secret
SOCIAL_LOGIN_COOKIE_KEY_SECRET_KEY=replace-with-another-long-random-secret
REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379/0

The secret examples here only illustrate the variable names; deployments should use secure random values. The social login callback also requires a usable app.ctx.redis.

docs.title: 3. Configure the application
docs.text:
The social login handlers read request.app.config.SOCIAL_CONFIG directly. At application startup, write the following configuration into the Sanic configuration and register the authentication routes:

import os
from sanic import Sanic
from redis.asyncio import Redis
from srf.auth.route import register_all_auth_urls
from srf.config import settings

app = Sanic("MyApp")
app.config.JWT_SECRET = os.environ["JWT_SECRET"]
app.config.SECRET_KEY = os.environ["SECRET_KEY"]
app.config.SOCIAL_LOGIN_COOKIE_KEY_SECRET_KEY = os.environ["SOCIAL_LOGIN_COOKIE_KEY_SECRET_KEY"]
app.config.SOCIAL_CONFIG = {
    "github": {
        "CLIENT_ID": os.environ["GITHUB_CLIENT_ID"],
        "CLIENT_SECRET": os.environ["GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET"],
        "AUTHORIZE_URL": "https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize",
        "REDIRECT_URI": os.environ["GITHUB_REDIRECT_URI"],
        "ACCESS_TOKEN_URL": "https://github.com/login/oauth/access_token",
        "OAUTH_SUCCESS_REDIRECT_URI": os.environ["OAUTH_SUCCESS_REDIRECT_URI"],
        "GITHUB_USER": "https://api.github.com/user",
        "GITHUB_USER_EMAIL": "https://api.github.com/user/emails",
    }
}

settings.set_app(app)
register_all_auth_urls(app, prefix="/api/auth")


@app.before_server_start
async def setup_redis(app):
    app.ctx.redis = Redis.from_url(os.environ["REDIS_URL"])


@app.before_server_stop
async def close_redis(app):
    await app.ctx.redis.aclose()

SOCIAL_LOGIN_COOKIE_KEY_SECRET_KEY is used to sign the OAuth state cookie. Production environments should set it to an independent random secret. Optional behavior settings are as follows:

Option Default Purpose SOCIAL_LOGIN_COOKIE_KEY_SECRET_KEY Falls back to JWT_SECRET HMAC-signs the OAuth state cookie SOCIAL_LOGIN_COOKIE_KEY oauth_state OAuth state cookie name SOCIAL_LOGIN_COOKIE_KEY_MAX_AGE 600 State cookie lifetime in seconds SOCIAL_LOGIN_COOKIE_SECURE Based on whether the current request is HTTPS Whether to send the cookie only over HTTPS SOCIAL_LOGIN_REDIS_CODE_PREFIX social-login Redis key prefix for one-time login codes SOCIAL_LOGIN_CODE_MAX_AGE 300 One-time login code lifetime in seconds

docs.title: Flow diagram
docs.text:
1. The user clicks "Sign in with GitHub"
   ↓
2. The frontend sends a request to POST /api/auth/social/github/login
   ↓
3. The backend generates a random state, writes the timestamped signed state into an HttpOnly cookie
   ↓
4. The backend redirects directly to the GitHub authorization page
   ↓
5. The user authorizes on GitHub
   ↓
6. GitHub redirects to the backend callback URL (with the OAuth code and state)
   ↓
7. The backend verifies the signed cookie, state, and validity period, then exchanges the code for an access_token
   ↓
8. The backend uses the access_token to fetch user information and a verified email
   ↓
9. The backend creates or retrieves the user account
   ↓
10. The backend generates a random one-time code and writes it to Redis as <prefix>:<code>
   ↓
11. The backend redirects to OAUTHCALLBACK?code=<temporary code>
   ↓
12. The frontend calls POST /api/auth/social/github/login_by_code with JSON {"code":"..."} to exchange for a JWT

docs.title: API endpoints
docs.text: The following GitHub OAuth endpoints are registered automatically by register_all_auth_urls(app) (or register_social_auth_urls(app) alone):

docs.title: 1. Get the authorization URL
docs.text:
Endpoint: POST /api/auth/social/github/login

Request:

curl -i -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/auth/social/github/login

The response is a 302 redirect, and a signed OAuth state cookie is written at the same time. The cookie uses HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, and its path comes from GITHUB_REDIRECT_URI; Secure is controlled by SOCIAL_LOGIN_COOKIE_SECURE and, when not configured, is decided by whether the current request is HTTPS.

Frontend handling:

const form = document.createElement("form");
form.method = "POST";
form.action = "/api/auth/social/github/login";
document.body.appendChild(form);
form.submit(); // The browser follows the backend 302 redirect to GitHub

docs.title: 2. Handle the callback
docs.text:
Endpoint: GET /api/auth/social/callback

This endpoint is triggered by the GitHub redirect. SRF automatically:

  1. Validates the state in the URL against the signed, time-limited cookie
  2. Exchanges the OAuth code for an access_token
  3. Fetches GitHub user information and selects a verified primary email (or the first verified email if there is no primary email)
  4. Creates or retrieves the local user account using the email; if no user exists for that email, SRF creates a local user and binds the OAuth account
  5. Generates a random one-time code and writes it to app.ctx.redis
  6. Redirects to SOCIAL_CONFIG['github']['OAUTH_SUCCESS_REDIRECT_URI']?code=<one-time code>
  7. Deletes the OAuth state cookie on the normal response path

The Redis key format defaults to social-login:<code>, with a default lifetime of 300 seconds. It can be overridden via SOCIAL_LOGIN_REDIS_CODE_PREFIX and SOCIAL_LOGIN_CODE_MAX_AGE.

URL format (GitHub → backend):

http://localhost:8000/api/auth/social/callback?code=xxx&state=xxx

docs.title: 3. Log in with the temporary code
docs.text:
Endpoint: POST /api/auth/social/github/login_by_code

Request (JSON body):

curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/auth/social/github/login_by_code \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"code":"one-time-code"}'

Response (flat structure: user fields + access_token, not a nested {"user": {...}}):

{
  "id": 1,
  "username": "github-user",
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "is_active": true,
  "is_superuser": false,
  "last_login": null,
  "roles": null,
  "create_time": "2026-01-01 00:00:00",
  "update_time": "2026-01-01 00:00:00",
  "access_token": "...",
  "refresh_token": "..."
}

docs.title: React example
docs.text:
import React, { useEffect } from "react";

function GitHubLogin() {
  const handleGitHubLogin = () => {
    // The backend redirects directly to GitHub and sets the OAuth state cookie.
    const form = document.createElement("form");
    form.method = "POST";
    form.action = "/api/auth/social/github/login";
    document.body.appendChild(form);
    form.submit(); // The browser follows the backend 302 redirect to GitHub
  };

  return <button onClick={handleGitHubLogin}>Sign in with GitHub</button>;
}

// Callback page (frontend route, corresponding to OAUTHCALLBACK)
function GitHubCallback() {
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleCallback = async () => {
      // Get the temporary code from the URL
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const code = params.get("code");

      if (!code) {
        console.error("No code received");
        return;
      }

      try {
        // 3. Put the temporary code in the JSON request body and exchange it for a JWT via POST
        const response = await fetch(`/api/auth/social/github/login_by_code`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ code }),
        });

        const data = await response.json();

        // 4. Save the token (the response has a flat structure)
        localStorage.setItem("access_token", data.access_token);

        // 5. Redirect to the home page
        window.location.href = "/";
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Failed to get token:", error);
      }
    };

    handleCallback();
  }, []);

  return <div>Signing in...</div>;
}

export { GitHubLogin, GitHubCallback };

docs.title: Extending to other login providers
docs.text: SRF currently only includes GitHub OAuth. Other providers require the application to implement OAuth authorization, callback validation, local user association, and login credential issuance itself; SRF does not automatically create routes or account binding logic for them.

docs.title: Security considerations
docs.text:
1. Validate the state parameter: prevent CSRF attacks

The framework generates a random state for each login, signs the state together with the issuance time using HMAC-SHA256, and writes it into an HttpOnly cookie. On callback it validates the signature, the lifetime, and the state in the URL at the same time, using hmac.compare_digest(). The cookie defaults to a 600-second lifetime and is deleted on a normal callback response. The signature only prevents tampering; it does not encrypt the state.

Production environments should configure an independent SOCIAL_LOGIN_COOKIE_KEY_SECRET_KEY so it can be rotated separately and its purpose isolated.

  1. HTTPS only: production environments must use HTTPS

  2. Limit scopes: request only the necessary permissions

  3. One-time exchange: the temporary code has a short expiry and is deleted atomically as soon as it is successfully exchanged

docs.title: Best practices
docs.text:
1. Offer multiple login methods: social login and traditional login can coexist; the application chooses how to integrate them
  2. Email policy: the current GitHub flow only accepts verified emails; the application should also handle email conflicts explicitly
  3. User agreement: show the user agreement and privacy policy on first login
  4. Error handling: provide friendly error messages
  5. Logging: log social login events

SRF currently looks up bound OAuth accounts by GitHub user ID; multi-provider account binding must be implemented separately by the application.

docs.text:

  • Read API Permissions to learn about permission control

docs.title: ViewSet Decorators
docs.text: ViewSet decorators extend and customize ViewSet behavior. The most important one is the @action decorator.

docs.title: The @action decorator
docs.text:
The @action decorator adds custom actions to a ViewSet, beyond the standard CRUD operations.

Action methods may be declared as async def or plain def; as_view() checks whether the return value is awaitable and awaits it only when needed.

docs.title: Basic usage
docs.text:
from datetime import datetime
from sanic.response import json
from srf.route import SanicRouter
from srf.views import BaseViewSet
from srf.views.decorators import action
from models import Product
from schemas import ProductSchemaReader


class ProductViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    @action(methods=["get"], detail=False, url_path="featured")
    async def list_featured(self, request):
        """Get featured products (collection-level action)"""
        products = await Product.filter(is_featured=True)
        data = [ProductSchemaReader.model_validate(p).model_dump(mode="json") for p in products]
        return json({"results": data})

    @action(methods=["post"], detail=True, url_path="publish")
    async def publish(self, request, pk):
        """Publish a product (detail-level action)"""
        product = await self.get_object(pk)
        product.is_published = True
        product.published_at = datetime.now()
        await product.save()

        return json({"message": "Product published"})

After registering the ViewSet with the router, you can call these actions with curl. The following example assumes app is a Sanic application that has already been created and configured with a database:

router = SanicRouter(app, prefix="api")
router.register("products", ProductViewSet, name="products")

# Collection-level action: query featured products
curl http://localhost:8000/api/products/featured

# Detail-level action: publish the product with ID 42
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/products/42/publish

docs.title: @action decorator parameters
docs.text:
from collections.abc import Sequence
from srf.views.decorators import action

action(
    *,
    detail: bool = False,                 # True for detail-level; False for collection-level
    methods: Sequence[str] = ("GET",),    # Default HTTP methods
    url_path: str | None = None,          # Default: "/<method name>"
    url_name: str | None = None,          # Default: method name
    **kwargs,
)

Parameter reference:

Parameter Type Default Description methods Sequence[str] ("GET",) List of HTTP methods, such as ["get"], ["post"], ["get", "post"] (case-insensitive on registration) detail bool False True for a detail-level action (requires pk), False for a collection-level action url_path str | None /<method name> Custom URL path segment url_name str | None Method name Route name, used for URL reverse resolution

docs.title: Collection-level actions (detail=False)
docs.text:
No resource ID is needed; the action applies to the whole collection.

Features:

  • No pk parameter
  • URL format: /api/products/action-name
  • Suitable for batch operations, statistics, search, etc.

Example:

The following snippets are all methods of ProductViewSet; they continue to use the imports from the earlier example.

from tortoise.functions import Count, Avg, Sum


@action(methods=["get"], detail=False, url_path="statistics")
async def get_statistics(self, request):
    """Get product statistics"""

    stats = await Product.all().annotate(
        total=Count("id"),
        avg_price=Avg("price"),
        total_value=Sum("price")
    ).values("total", "avg_price", "total_value")

    return json(stats[0] if stats else {})


@action(methods=["post"], detail=False, url_path="bulk-update")
async def bulk_update(self, request):
    """Bulk update products"""
    ids = request.json.get("ids", [])
    updates = request.json.get("updates", {})

    if not ids:
        return json({"error": "Please provide a list of product IDs"}, status=400)

    await Product.filter(id__in=ids).update(**updates)

    return json({"message": f"Successfully updated {len(ids)} products"})


@action(methods=["get"], detail=False, url_path="search")
async def advanced_search(self, request):
    """Advanced search"""
    keyword = request.args.get("q", "")
    category = request.args.get("category")

    queryset = Product.all()

    if keyword:
        queryset = queryset.filter(name__icontains=keyword)

    if category:
        queryset = queryset.filter(category_id=category)

    products = await queryset
    data = [ProductSchemaReader.model_validate(p).model_dump(mode="json") for p in products]

    return json({"results": data})

Generated routes:

  • GET /api/products/statistics
  • POST /api/products/bulk-update
  • GET /api/products/search

Corresponding curl examples:

curl "http://localhost:8000/api/products/statistics"
curl "http://localhost:8000/api/products/search?q=keyboard&category=2"
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/products/bulk-update \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"ids":[1,2],"updates":{"is_active":false}}'

docs.title: Detail-level actions (detail=True)
docs.text:
A resource ID is required; the action applies to a single resource.

Features:

  • Requires a pk parameter
  • URL format: /api/products/<pk>/action-name
  • Suitable for state changes, related operations, etc.

Example:

@action(methods=["post"], detail=True, url_path="activate")
async def activate(self, request, pk):
    """Activate a product"""
    product = await self.get_object(pk)

    if product.is_active:
        return json({"error": "The product is already active"}, status=400)

    product.is_active = True
    await product.save()

    return json({"message": "Product activated"})


@action(methods=["post"], detail=True, url_path="duplicate")
async def duplicate(self, request, pk):
    """Duplicate a product"""
    product = await self.get_object(pk)

    # Duplicate the product
    new_product = await Product.create(
        name=f"{product.name} (Copy)",
        price=product.price,
        description=product.description,
        category_id=product.category_id
    )

    data = ProductSchemaReader.model_validate(new_product).model_dump()

    return json(data, status=201)


@action(methods=["get"], detail=True, url_path="related")
async def get_related(self, request, pk):
    """Get related products"""
    product = await self.get_object(pk)

    # Other products in the same category
    related = await Product.filter(category_id=product.category_id).exclude(id=product.id).limit(5)

    data = [ProductSchemaReader.model_validate(p).model_dump(mode="json") for p in related]

    return json({"results": data})

Generated routes:

  • POST /api/products/<pk>/activate
  • POST /api/products/<pk>/duplicate
  • GET /api/products/<pk>/related

Corresponding curl examples:

curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/products/42/activate
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/products/42/duplicate
curl http://localhost:8000/api/products/42/related

docs.title: Multiple HTTP methods
docs.text:
An action can support multiple HTTP methods:

from models import Comment


@action(methods=["get", "post"], detail=True, url_path="comments")
async def handle_comments(self, request, pk):
    """Handle comments (GET to fetch, POST to add)"""
    product = await self.get_object(pk)

    if request.method == "GET":
        # Get comments
        comments = await product.comments.all()
        return json({"results": [{"id": c.id, "content": c.content} for c in comments]})

    elif request.method == "POST":
        # Add a comment
        content = request.json.get("content")
        comment = await Comment.create(
            product=product,
            user=request.ctx.user,
            content=content
        )
        return json({"id": comment.id, "content": comment.content}, status=201)

The same URL can perform different operations depending on the HTTP method:

# Get comments for the product with ID 42
curl http://localhost:8000/api/products/42/comments

# Add a comment (request middleware must have set request.ctx.user)
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/products/42/comments \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <access-token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"content":"Very useful"}'

docs.title: Custom URL path
docs.text:
Use the url_path parameter to customize the URL:

@action(methods=["post"], detail=True, url_path="change-status")
async def change_status(self, request, pk):
    """Change status"""
    product = await self.get_object(pk)
    new_status = request.json.get("status")

    product.status = new_status
    await product.save()

    return json({"message": "Status updated"})

URL: POST /api/products/<pk>/change-status

curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/products/42/change-status \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"status":"archived"}'

When url_path is omitted, it defaults to /<method name> (underscores are not converted):

@action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
async def change_status(self, request, pk):
    """Change status"""
    pass

URL: POST /api/products/<pk>/change_status

docs.title: Custom route name
docs.text:
Use the url_name parameter to customize the route name, which is used for URL reverse resolution:

@action(detail=False, methods=["get"], url_path="featured", url_name="featured_list")
async def featured(self, request):
    """Featured list"""
    pass


# Reverse resolution; when registered directly on the Sanic application, the name is products-featured_list
url = request.app.url_for("products-featured_list")

docs.title: Permission control
docs.text:
You can perform permission checks inside an action:

from srf.permission.permission import SuperuserOnly
from sanic.exceptions import Forbidden


@action(methods=["post"], detail=True, url_path="approve")
async def approve(self, request, pk):
    """Approve a product (admin only)"""
    # Check administrator permission
    if not SuperuserOnly.has_permission(request, self):
        raise Forbidden("Superuser permission required")

    product = await self.get_object(pk)
    product.is_approved = True
    await product.save()

    return json({"message": "Approved"})

docs.title: Complete example
docs.text: Combine the action methods above with the regular ViewSet configuration; see ViewSet for complete CRUD and schema configuration.

docs.title: Best practices
docs.text:
1. Semantic naming: method names should clearly express the intent of the operation
  2. Appropriate grouping: related operations should use consistent URL path prefixes
  3. Permission checks: add permission validation for sensitive operations
  4. Error handling: provide friendly error messages
  5. Docstrings: add clear documentation for each action
  6. HTTP methods: follow RESTful conventions (GET for queries, POST for creation/operations)
  7. Idempotency: GET operations should be idempotent

docs.title: State changes
docs.text:
@action(methods=["post"], detail=True, url_path="archive")
async def archive(self, request, pk):
    """Archive"""
    obj = await self.get_object(pk)
    obj.status = "archived"
    await obj.save()
    return json({"message": "Archived"})

docs.title: Related resources
docs.text:
@action(methods=["get"], detail=True, url_path="reviews")
async def get_reviews(self, request, pk):
    """Get reviews"""
    obj = await self.get_object(pk)
    reviews = await obj.reviews.all()
    return json({"results": [{"id": review.id} for review in reviews]})

docs.title: Batch operations
docs.text:
@action(methods=["post"], detail=False, url_path="bulk-update")
async def bulk_update(self, request):
    """Bulk update"""
    ids = request.json.get("ids", [])
    updates = request.json.get("updates", {})
    await Product.filter(id__in=ids).update(**updates)
    return json({"message": "Updated successfully"})

docs.title: Next steps
docs.text:
• Read Routing to learn about the routing system
  • Study Permissions to add permission control
  • See ViewSet for ViewSet basics

docs.title: Views (ViewSet)
docs.text: ViewSet is one of the core concepts of SRF. It provides an elegant way to organize and manage RESTful API endpoints.

docs.title: What is a ViewSet?
docs.text: A ViewSet is a class-based view that groups related API operations together. A ViewSet usually corresponds to one resource type (such as products or orders) and provides CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for that resource.

docs.title: Basic concepts
docs.text:
• Resource-oriented: Each ViewSet corresponds to one resource type
  • Automatic routing: RESTful routes are generated automatically
  • Mixin pattern: Functionality is composed through mixins
  • Flexible extension: Custom actions are supported

docs.title: BaseViewSet
docs.text: BaseViewSet is the base class for all ViewSets and inherits all CRUD mixins. Code blocks below that do not repeat imports are method snippets to add to an existing ViewSet and continue to use the BaseViewSet, Product, and schema imports from the basic usage section.

docs.title: Basic usage
docs.text:
from srf.views import BaseViewSet
from models import Product
from schemas import ProductSchemaReader, ProductSchemaWriter


class ProductViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    """Product ViewSet"""

    @property
    def queryset(self):
        """Return the queryset"""
        return Product.all()

    def get_schema(self):
        """Choose the read/write schema by HTTP method; self.request is set by as_view."""
        return ProductSchemaReader if self.request.is_safe else ProductSchemaWriter

docs.title: 1. queryset / get_queryset
docs.text:
Provides the Tortoise ORM queryset. To limit the data scope per request, prefer overriding get_queryset(); you can also set a class attribute or @property named queryset, which the default get_queryset() reads (cloning it with .all() if it is a QuerySet).

list() uses filter_queryset(self.get_queryset()). get_object() and perform_create() also go through get_queryset().

# Class attribute
queryset = Product.all()


# Or a property (still read by get_queryset)
@property
def queryset(self):
    """Return only published products"""
    return Product.filter(is_published=True)


# Or override get_queryset to limit the scope per request
def get_queryset(self):
    return Product.filter(owner_id=self.request.ctx.user.id).prefetch_related("category", "tags")

docs.title: 2. The get_schema method
docs.text:
Returns the Pydantic schema used for validation and serialization.

To always use one schema, just set the schema class attribute. To choose based on the request or action, override get_schema(); see Schema selection for how to choose and how the built-in create / update use the returned schema.

Why separate read and write schemas?

  • Security: exclude read-only fields on write (such as id, created_at)
  • Flexibility: include computed fields and related data on read
  • Validation: use stricter validation rules on write

Example:

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, ConfigDict
from typing import Optional


class ProductSchemaWriter(BaseModel):
    """Write schema - used for create and update"""

    name: str = Field(..., max_length=100)
    price: float = Field(..., gt=0)
    description: Optional[str] = None
    category_id: int


class ProductSchemaReader(BaseModel):
    """Read schema - used for serialization"""

    id: int
    name: str
    price: float
    description: Optional[str]
    category_id: int
    category_name: str  # Additional related field
    created_at: str

    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

docs.title: CRUD operations
docs.text: BaseViewSet provides standard CRUD operations through mixins.

docs.title: ListModelMixin - list operation
docs.text:
Route: GET /api/products

Features:

  • Get a resource list
  • Supports pagination
  • Supports sorting

Response format:

{
  "count": 100,
  "next": true,
  "previous": false,
  "results": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Product 1",
      "price": 99.99
    }
  ]
}

Custom list method:

from sanic.response import json
from srf.paginator import PageNumberPagination


class ProductViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    async def list(self, request):
        """Custom list logic"""
        # Get the queryset
        queryset = self.queryset

        # Apply filtering
        if "category" in request.args:
            category_id = request.args.get("category")
            queryset = queryset.filter(category_id=category_id)

        # Apply filter classes
        for filter_class in self.filter_class:
            queryset = filter_class(self).filter_queryset(request, queryset)

        paginator = PageNumberPagination.from_queryset(queryset, request)
        schema = self.get_schema()
        result = await paginator.to_dict(schema)

        return json(result)

docs.title: CreateModelMixin - create operation
docs.text:
Route: POST /api/products

Feature: Create a new resource

Request body:

{
  "name": "New product",
  "price": 99.99,
  "description": "Product description",
  "category_id": 1
}

Response:

{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "New product",
  "price": 99.99,
  "description": "Product description",
  "category_id": 1,
  "created_at": "2026-02-07 10:00:00"
}

Custom create logic:

class ProductViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    async def perform_create(self, sch_model):
        """Custom create logic

        Args:
            sch_model: The validated Pydantic schema instance

        Use self.request when the request is needed (as_view assigns it).
        """
        data = sch_model.model_dump(exclude_unset=True, by_alias=False)
        data["created_by"] = self.request.ctx.user.id

        obj = await Product.create(**data)
        await self.send_notification(obj)
        return obj

    async def send_notification(self, product):
        """Send a notification"""
        # Implement notification logic
        pass

docs.title: RetrieveModelMixin - retrieve operation
docs.text:
Route: GET /api/products/<pk>

Feature: Get a single resource

Response:

{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "Product 1",
  "price": 99.99,
  "description": "Product description",
  "category_id": 1,
  "category_name": "Electronics",
  "created_at": "2026-02-07 10:00:00"
}

Custom retrieve logic:

class ProductViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    async def retrieve(self, request, pk):
        """Custom retrieve logic"""
        # Get the object
        obj = await self.get_object(pk)

        # Log the access
        await self.log_view(obj, request.ctx.user)

        # Serialize
        schema = self.get_schema()
        data = schema.model_validate(obj).model_dump()

        from sanic.response import json

        return json(data)

    async def log_view(self, product, user):
        """Log a view"""
        # Implement view logging logic
        pass

docs.title: UpdateModelMixin - update operation
docs.text:
Route: PUT /api/products/<pk> or PATCH /api/products/<pk>

Feature: Update a resource

Request body:

{
  "name": "Updated product name",
  "price": 109.99,
  "description": "Product description",
  "category_id": 1
}

This is not a partial update currently

update() validates the full request body with the schema returned by get_schema() using strict=True, and PUT and PATCH map to the same method. The request body must satisfy the schema's required fields; exclude_unset=True in perform_update() only controls "which validated fields are written back to the database", and does not mean required fields can be omitted.

Response:

{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "Updated product name",
  "price": 109.99,
  "updated_at": "2026-02-07 11:00:00"
}

Custom update logic:

class ProductViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    async def perform_update(self, sch_model, orm_model):
        """Custom update logic

        Args:
            sch_model: The validated Pydantic schema instance
            orm_model: The ORM model instance to update

        Returns:
            The updated model instance
        """
        # Record the change
        old_price = orm_model.price

        # Update the object
        update_data = sch_model.model_dump(exclude_unset=True, exclude_none=True, exclude=["id"], by_alias=False)
        for field, value in update_data.items():
            if hasattr(orm_model, field):
                setattr(orm_model, field, value)
        await orm_model.save()

        # If the price changed, send a notification
        if old_price != orm_model.price:
            await self.notify_price_change(orm_model, old_price)

        return orm_model

    async def notify_price_change(self, product, old_price):
        """Notify about a price change"""
        # Implement notification logic
        pass

docs.title: DestroyModelMixin - delete operation
docs.text:
Route: DELETE /api/products/<pk>

Feature: Delete a resource

Response: HTTP 204 No Content

Custom delete logic:

class ProductViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    async def perform_destroy(self, orm_model):
        """Custom delete logic

        Args:
            orm_model: The ORM model instance to delete
        """
        # Soft delete
        orm_model.is_deleted = True
        await orm_model.save()

        # Or hard delete
        # await orm_model.delete()

        # Clean up related data
        await self.cleanup_related(orm_model)

    async def cleanup_related(self, product):
        """Clean up related data"""
        # Delete related images, comments, etc.
        pass

docs.title: Custom actions - the @action decorator
docs.text: @action is used to add endpoints beyond CRUD: detail=False registers /api/products/<url_path>, while detail=True registers /api/products/<pk>/<url_path>. See ViewSet Decorators for complete details on parameters, examples, permission checks, and more.

docs.title: Permission control
docs.text:
from srf.permission.permission import IsAuthenticated, SuperuserOnly


class ProductViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    permission_classes = (IsAuthenticated, SuperuserOnly)

docs.title: Search fields
docs.text: All three field configurations default to an empty list [] and also accept dictionaries. Field names in a list map directly to same-named ORM fields; dictionary values specify the ORM field name, while the keys of filter_fields and ordering_fields are used as query parameter names and ordering names respectively. See Filtering for details.

docs.title: Filter fields
docs.text:
class ProductViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    filter_fields = {
        "category": "category_id",
        "min_price": "price__gte",
        "max_price": "price__lte",
        "is_published": "is_published",
    }

docs.title: Ordering fields
docs.text:
class ProductViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    ordering_fields = {
        "price": "price",
        "name": "name",
        "created": "created_at",
    }

docs.title: Filter classes
docs.text:
class ProductViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    filter_class = [
        SearchFilter,
        QueryParamFilter,
        OrderingFactory,
    ]

docs.title: Complete example
docs.text:
from srf.views import BaseViewSet
from srf.permission.permission import IsAuthenticated
from models import Product
from schemas import ProductSchemaReader, ProductSchemaWriter


class ProductViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    """Product ViewSet - complete example"""

    # Permission configuration
    permission_classes = (IsAuthenticated,)

    # Search configuration
    search_fields = ["name", "description", "sku"]

    # Filter configuration
    filter_fields = {
        "category": "category_id",
        "min_price": "price__gte",
        "max_price": "price__lte",
    }

    # Ordering configuration
    ordering_fields = {
        "price": "price",
        "name": "name",
        "created": "created_at",
    }

    @property
    def queryset(self):
        """Return the queryset"""
        return Product.all().prefetch_related("category")

    def get_schema(self):
        """Choose the schema by HTTP method."""
        return ProductSchemaReader if self.request.is_safe else ProductSchemaWriter

    # Custom create logic
    async def perform_create(self, sch_model):
        """Create a product; use self.request when the request is needed"""
        data = sch_model.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
        data["created_by"] = self.request.ctx.user.id
        return await Product.create(**data)

    # Custom update logic
    async def perform_update(self, sch_model, orm_model):
        """Update a product"""
        update_data = sch_model.model_dump(exclude_unset=True, exclude_none=True, exclude=["id"], by_alias=False)
        for field, value in update_data.items():
            if hasattr(orm_model, field):
                setattr(orm_model, field, value)
        orm_model.updated_by = self.request.ctx.user.id
        await orm_model.save()
        return orm_model

docs.title: Best practices
docs.text:
1. Keep ViewSets concise: complex logic should live in a service layer or manager
  2. Use perform_* methods: override perform_create, perform_update, and similar methods for custom logic
  3. Use @action sensibly: add custom endpoints for specific business operations
  4. Permission checks: always add permission checks for sensitive operations
  5. Exception handling: catch and handle possible exceptions
  6. Docstrings: add clear docstrings to methods

docs.title: Sanic RESTful framework
docs.text: 欢迎使用 Sanic RESTful framework (SRF) —— 一个基于 Sanic 的强大而灵活的 RESTful API 开发框架。

docs.title: 什么是 SRF？
docs.text:
Sanic RESTful framework（后文称为 SRF） 是一个基于 Sanic 应用设计的现代化 RESTful API 开发框架，它提供了一套完整的工具和最佳实践，帮助您快速构建高性能的 Web API。

SRF 受到 Django REST framework（后文称为 DRF）的启发，将其优秀的设计理念移植到了异步的 Sanic 生态系统中，如果您熟悉 DRF 框架，那您很快就能上手使用 SRF，即使您不熟悉 DRF 也没关系，SRF 的便捷性一定能帮您快速构建您的应用！

docs.title: 为什么选择 SRF？
docs.text:
• 🚀 高性能：以 Sanic 为基础架构，具有卓越的性能
  • 📦 常用组件：提供认证、权限、分页、过滤、限流等基础组件
  • 🎯 简单易用：使用体验最接近 Django REST Framework，学习曲线平缓
  • 🔧 灵活可扩展：模块化设计，可以轻松定制和扩展
  • 🔒 安全扩展点：提供 JWT、权限和限流组件；生产安全仍需应用配置和审计
  • 📊 开箱即用：提供健康检查、异常处理、HTTP 状态码等实用工具

docs.title: ViewSet 和路由
docs.text:
• 基于类的视图集（ViewSet），自动生成 RESTful 路由
  • 支持标准的 CRUD 操作（Create, Read, Update, Delete, List 等）
  • 通过 @action 装饰器轻松添加自定义操作
  • 自动路由发现和注册

docs.title: 认证与授权
docs.text:
• JWT（JSON Web Token）认证支持
  • 社交登录集成（GitHub OAuth等）
  • 灵活的权限系统（IsAuthenticated、SafeMethodOnly、SuperuserOnly 等）
  • 提供认证中间件工具，需由应用按路由策略接入

docs.title: 数据处理
docs.text:
• 基于 Pydantic 的数据验证和序列化
  • 页码分页、排序功能

docs.title: 安全特性
docs.text:
• 限流中间件（基于 IP、用户、路径等）
  • CSRF 防护由应用根据认证方式自行接入
  • 密码加密（bcrypt）
  • 认证密钥由应用显式配置

docs.title: 快速预览
docs.text:
下面是一个简单的示例，展示如何使用 SRF 创建一个 RESTful API：

from sanic import Sanic
from srf.views import BaseViewSet
from srf.route import SanicRouter

from tortoise import fields
from tortoise.models import Model
from tortoise.contrib.sanic import register_tortoise
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict


# 定义 ORM 模型
class Product(Model):
    id = fields.IntField(pk=True)
    name = fields.CharField(max_length=100)
    price = fields.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2)
    description = fields.TextField()


# 定义 Schema 模型
class ProductSchema(BaseModel):
    id: int | None = None
    name: str
    price: float
    description: str
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)


# 定义 ViewSet
class ProductViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    schema = ProductSchema

    @property
    def queryset(self):
        return Product.all()


# 创建应用和路由
app = Sanic("MyApp")
register_tortoise(app, db_url=*, modules=*})
router = SanicRouter(app, prefix="api")
router.register("products", ProductViewSet)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(host="0.0.0.0", port=8000)

注册路由后即可使用这些 ViewSet 端点；

  • GET /api/products - 获取产品列表
  • POST /api/products - 创建新产品
  • GET /api/products/<pk> - 获取单个产品
  • PUT/PATCH /api/products/<pk> - 更新产品
  • DELETE /api/products/<pk> - 删除产品

docs.title: 配置
docs.text:
SRF 使用 srf.config.settings（LazySettings）读取配置。查找顺序为：

  1. 最近一次通过 settings.set_app(app) 绑定的 app.config
  2. srf.config.settings 模块中的大写默认值

docs.title: 初始化
docs.text:
请在 Sanic 配置中设置：

from sanic import Sanic
from srf.config import settings

app = Sanic("MyApp")
settings.set_app(app)

LazySettings 是进程级单例。多应用共用一个进程时，后一次 set_app() 会影响 所有通过 settings 读取配置的代码。

docs.title: 默认配置
docs.text: 以下配置项定义在 srf/config/settings.py，以源码为准。

docs.title: 分页 / 过滤 / 权限
docs.text:
ViewSet 未声明对应类属性时使用的默认值。

配置项 默认值 说明 PAGINATION_CLASS PageNumberPagination 默认分页类 DEFAULT_FILTERS [SearchFilter, QueryParamFilter, OrderingFactory 等] 默认过滤器链 DEFAULT_PERMISSION_CLASSES (AllowAny,) 默认权限类

docs.title: 序列化与缓存
docs.text: 配置项 默认值 说明 BASE_DIR os.getcwd() 项目根目录（进程工作目录） CACHE_ROOT BASE_DIR/.diskcache 缓存目录 DATETIME_FORMAT "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S" 时间字符串模板 JSON_ENCODER custom_dumps JSON 序列化函数（处理 datetime / Exception），需应用自行接入 Sanic

docs.title: 健康检查与限流
docs.text:
健康检查路由实际读取 app.config.HEALTH_CHECK_LIST：

from srf.health.checks import RedisCheck

app.config.HEALTH_CHECK_LIST = [RedisCheck]
app.ctx.redis = redis_client
配置项 默认值 说明 HEALTH_CHECK_LIST [] 健康检查类列表 REQUEST_LIMITERS [] 限流器列表，throttle_rate() 优先读 app.config.REQUEST_LIMITERS，未设置时回退 settings.REQUEST_LIMITERS THROTTLE_REDIS_PREFIX "throttle" 限流 Redis 键前缀（RedisStorage）

docs.title: 邮件
docs.text:
srf.tools.email.send_email() 读取 settings.EMAIL_CONFIG。 LazySettings 会优先使用 app.config.EMAIL_CONFIG，因此可以在应用启动时覆盖； 未覆盖时使用 srf.config.settings.EMAIL_CONFIG，其属性在模块导入时从环境变量读取。

属性 环境变量 说明 EMAIL_CONFIG.from_email FROM_EMAIL 发件人地址 EMAIL_CONFIG.smtp_server SMTP_SERVER SMTP 服务器 EMAIL_CONFIG.smtp_port SMTP_PORT SMTP 端口 EMAIL_CONFIG.password PASSWORD 邮箱密码 / 授权码

docs.title: 社交登录
docs.text:
GitHub OAuth 的使用教程见社交登录。

配置项 默认值 说明 SOCIAL_CONFIG GitHub OAuth 配置字典 各字段从 GITHUB_CLIENT_ID 等环境变量读取 SOCIAL_LOGIN_COOKIE_KEY "oauth_state" OAuth state 的 Cookie 名 SOCIAL_LOGIN_COOKIE_KEY_MAX_AGE 600 state Cookie 有效期（秒）

docs.title: 注册验证码与密码
docs.text: 配置项 默认值 说明 MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH 8 密码最小长度 USER_REGISTER_EMAIL_VERIFY_CODE_TTL 60 验证码有效期（秒） USER_REGISTER_EMAIL_CODE "USER_REGISTER:EMAIL_CODE:{email}" 验证码 Redis 键模板 USER_REGISTER_EMAIL_CODE_TIMES "USER_REGISTER:EMAIL_CODE_TIMES:{email}" 失败次数 Redis 键模板 USER_REGISTER_EMAIL_CODE_TIMES_LIMIT 10 验证码失败次数上限

docs.title: JWT
docs.text:
JWT_SECRET（签名密钥）与 SECRET_KEY（刷新令牌摘要密钥）无默认值，必须在 app.config 中显式设置。register_jwt_urls() 会将 JWT_ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRES 换算为 秒并传给 sanic-jwt。

配置项 默认值 说明 JWT_ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRES timedelta(hours=24) 访问令牌有效期 JWT_REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRES timedelta(days=30) 刷新令牌有效期

docs.title: 最佳实践
docs.text:
1. 分离敏感信息：使用环境变量存储密钥和密码
  2. 多环境配置：为开发、测试、生产环境创建不同配置
  3. 使用 .env 文件：便于本地开发
  4. 不要提交 .env：将 .env 添加到 .gitignore
  5. 提供默认值：使用 os.getenv() 的第二个参数提供默认值
  6. 验证配置：应用启动时验证必需的配置项（如 JWT_SECRET）
  7. 文档化配置：在 README 中说明所有配置项

docs.title: 特点
docs.text: Sanic RESTful framework（SRF） 提供了一套完整的工具和功能，帮助您快速构建高质量的 RESTful API。

docs.title: 🎯 基于类的视图集（ViewSet）
docs.text:
ViewSet 是 SRF 的核心概念，它提供了一种优雅的方式来组织和管理 API 端点。

特点：

  • 自动生成标准的 RESTful 路由
  • 内置 CRUD 基本视图函数（Create, Read, Update, Delete, List）
  • 支持 Mixin 模式，灵活组合功能
  • 通过 @action 装饰器轻松添加自定义路由视图函数
  • 快速开发，接近 Django REST Framework 的开发体验

优势：

  • 减少重复代码，提高开发效率
  • 统一的代码风格和结构
  • 易于测试和维护

docs.title: 🎨 自动路由生成
docs.text:
SanicRouter 自动为 ViewSet 生成路由：

标准路由：

  • GET /api/resource → list
  • POST /api/resource → create
  • GET /api/resource/<pk> → retrieve
  • PUT/PATCH /api/resource/<pk> → update
  • DELETE /api/resource/<pk> → destroy

自定义路由：

  • 通过 @action 装饰器定义
  • 自动发现并注册
  • 支持集合级和详情级操作

docs.title: 🔐 认证组件
docs.text:
SRF 提供了多种认证方式，满足不同场景的需求。

支持的认证方式：

  • JWT 认证：基于 JSON Web Token 的无状态认证
  • 社交登录：支持 GitHub OAuth（可扩展其他平台）
  • 邮箱验证：内置邮箱验证码功能

认证特性：

  • 提供 Token 校验中间件（由应用接入）
  • 通过内置及自定义权限类实现权限控制
  • 密码加密存储（bcrypt）
  • JWT 密钥需由应用显式配置；认证中间件由应用接入

docs.title: 🛡️ 灵活的权限系统
docs.text:
基于类的权限系统，支持视图级和对象级权限控制。

内置权限类：

  • AllowAny：始终允许（未声明 permission_classes 时的默认）
  • IsAuthenticated：用户必须已登录
  • SuperuserOnly：用户必须是超级用户
  • SafeMethodOnly：仅允许安全的 HTTP 方法（GET, HEAD, OPTIONS）
  • 基于BasePermission实现自定义的权限管控

docs.title: 数据验证与序列化
docs.text:
• 基于 Pydantic 的数据验证
  • 自动数据序列化和反序列化
  • 支持读写 Schema 分离
  • 类型安全，IDE 友好

docs.title: 过滤系统
docs.text:
SRF 提供了多种过滤器，可以组合使用：

  1. SearchFilter：按 search_fields 配置的字段做关键词包含匹配
  2. QueryParamFilter：基于查询参数的精确过滤
  3. OrderingFactory：排序功能
  4. 其他...

docs.title: 分页
docs.text:
• 基于页码的分页
  • 可通过查询参数设置每页数量（最大 100）
  • 返回统一的分页响应格式

docs.title: 🚦 限流中间件
docs.text:
保护您的 API 免受滥用，支持多种限流策略：

  • IPRateLimit：基于 IP 地址限流
  • UserRateLimit：基于用户 ID 限流
  • PathRateLimit：基于请求路径 + 用户/IP 限流
  • HeaderRateLimit：基于请求头限流

存储方式：

  • 内存存储（MemoryStorage）
  • Redis 存储（RedisStorage）

docs.title: 🏥 健康检查
docs.text:
内置健康检查功能，监控应用和依赖服务的状态。通过配置 HEALTH_CHECK_LIST 注册要运行的检查类。

内置服务检查：

  • RedisCheck（Redis）
  • SQLiteCheck（SQLite）

特点：

  • 执行配置的检查并返回状态映射
  • 当前检查失败时响应仍为 HTTP 200
  • 易于集成到监控系统

docs.title: 📝 审计事件
docs.text: SRF 提供 Event 模型、EventSchema 和仅超级用户可访问的 EventViewSet，用于创建、列表和读取事件。事件记录需由应用主动写入；框架不会自动记录所有请求。

docs.title: HTTP 状态码
docs.text:
• 常用 HTTP 状态码枚举
  • 语义化的常量命名（如 HTTP_200_OK, HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND）

docs.title: 异常处理
docs.text:
• ViewSet 内对部分异常进行转换
  • 自定义异常类
  • 全局统一响应需由应用注册 Sanic 异常处理器

docs.title: 邮件发送
docs.text:
• 基于标准库 smtplib 的同步 SMTP（srf/tools/email.py）
  • send_email(to_email, subject, content) 发送 HTML 内容邮件（同步）
  • send_template_email(...) 提供异步模板邮件发送，内部在线程中执行 SMTP
  • 注册验证码默认为六位数字，并支持 Redis TTL 和错误次数限制

docs.title: 约定优于配置
docs.text: SRF 遵循"约定优于配置"的原则，提供合理的默认配置，让您可以快速开始开发。同时保持高度的可配置性，在需要时可以自定义任何行为。

docs.title: 模块化与可扩展
docs.text: SRF 采用模块化设计，每个功能都是独立的模块，可以根据需要选择使用。同时提供了清晰的扩展点，方便您添加自定义功能。

docs.title: 类型安全
docs.text: 通过 Pydantic 和类型注解，SRF 提供了良好的类型安全性，减少运行时错误，提高代码质量。

docs.title: 异步优先
docs.text: 充分利用 Python 的 asyncio 特性和 Sanic 的异步架构，提供高性能的 API 服务。

docs.title: 性能优势
docs.text:
• 异步 I/O：基于 Sanic，原生支持 async/await
  • 高效路由：自动生成和注册路由，减少运行时开销
  • 模块化：按需接入各组件，数据缓存由应用自行实现
  • 轻量级：核心功能精简，按需加载模块

docs.title: 生态完善
docs.text: • 以 Sanic 为基础框架，可以和生态中各种框架完美融合

docs.title: IDE 友好
docs.text:
• 完整的类型注解
  • 清晰的代码结构
  • 良好的代码提示和自动补全

docs.title: 易于测试
docs.text:
• 基于类的设计便于单元测试
  • 清晰的接口和职责分离
  • 支持 Mock 和依赖注入

docs.title: 文档完善
docs.text:
• 详细的多语言文档
  • 丰富的代码示例
  • API 参考文档

docs.title: 适用场景
docs.text:
SRF 适合以下场景：

  • ✅ 构建 RESTful API 服务
  • ✅ 需要高并发处理的应用
  • ✅ 微服务架构
  • ✅ 前后端分离项目
  • ✅ 移动应用后端
  • ✅ 物联网平台
  • ✅ 数据 API 服务

docs.text: 特性 Sanic RESTful framework FastAPI Django REST framework 异步支持 ✅ 完整 ✅ 完整 ⚠️ 部分 性能 🚀很高 🚀 较高 ⚡ 中等 开发速度 很快 快 很快 学习曲线 📈 平缓 📈 平缓 📈 陡峭 ViewSet ✅ 支持 ❌ 不支持 ✅ 支持 数据验证 Pydantic Pydantic Serializer ORM Tortoise(其他ORM扩展中) SQLAlchemy/其他 Django ORM 社区 🌱 成长中 🌳 活跃 🌲 成熟

docs.title: 发布说明
docs.text:
Sanic RESTful framework 的版本发布历史和更新日志。

当前包版本：srf.__version__ == "0.1.3"。

docs.title: 版本命名规则
docs.text:
SRF 遵循 语义化版本 规范：

  • 主版本号：不兼容的 API 变更
  • 次版本号：向后兼容的功能性新增
  • 修订号：向后兼容的问题修正

格式：主版本号.次版本号.修订号

docs.title: v0.1.3
docs.text:
路由、分页、限流修复与认证接口拆分

  • 修复 HEAD 请求 405、同步 @action 500、GitHub 登录缺少 id 等问题
  • 分页参数非法值回退并夹取到合法范围，空结果页码为 1
  • Redis 限流计数与过期时间改为 Lua 原子操作
  • 认证路由拆分为 register_jwt_urls() 等函数，新增 change-password / reset-password
  • 健康检查模块改为 srf.health.route；邮件配置可用 app.config.EMAIL_CONFIG 覆盖
  • 中英文文档同步，新增 tests/test_jwt_flow.py

docs.title: v0.1.1
docs.text:
• 登录请求使用 account 字段，支持用户名或邮箱。
  • 邮箱验证码使用六位数字，并通过 Redis Lua 脚本原子处理验证码和错误次数。
  • 增加异步模板邮件接口 send_template_email()。
  • GitHub OAuth 登录增加一次性登录码流程。

docs.title: v0.0.2 (2026-02-07)
docs.text: 首个正式版本发布 🎉

docs.title: 核心功能
docs.text:
• ✅ ViewSet 系统
  • BaseViewSet 实现
  • CRUD Mixins (Create, Retrieve, Update, Destroy, List)
  • @action 装饰器支持自定义操作

  • 自动路由生成

  • ✅ 路由系统

  • SanicRouter 路由管理器
  • 自动发现 @action 装饰的方法
  • 支持集合级和详情级操作

  • URL 前缀和命名支持

  • ✅ 认证与授权

  • JWT (JSON Web Token) 认证
  • 社交登录（GitHub OAuth）
  • 邮箱验证码
  • 权限类系统（AllowAny、IsAuthenticated、SafeMethodOnly、SuperuserOnly）

  • 认证中间件

  • ✅ 数据处理

  • 基于 Pydantic 的数据验证
  • 读写 Schema 分离

  • 自动序列化和反序列化

  • ✅ 过滤与搜索

  • SearchFilter - 按 search_fields 配置搜索字段
  • QueryParamFilter - 精确过滤

  • OrderingFactory - 排序

  • ✅ 分页

  • 基于页码的分页
  • 可配置每页数量

  • 统一的分页响应格式

  • ✅ 中间件

  • 认证中间件
  • 限流中间件（IP、用户、路径、请求头）

  • 认证与限流中间件（不包含 CSRF 中间件）

  • ✅ 健康检查

  • 可扩展的健康检查系统（通过 HEALTH_CHECK_LIST 注册）

  • 内置 RedisCheck、SQLiteCheck

  • ✅ 异常处理

  • 统一的异常处理机制
  • 自定义异常类

  • 标准化的错误响应

  • ✅ 工具类

  • HTTP 状态码枚举
  • 邮件发送功能
  • 配置管理系统

docs.title: API 参考：Exceptions
docs.text:
SRF 的公开异常都继承自 Sanic 的 HTTPException，由 Sanic 统一转换成 JSON 响应。使用说明见 异常。

from srf.exceptions import (
    ImproperlyConfigured,
    PydanticValidationException,
    TargetObjectAlreadyExist,
    TooManyRequest,
)

docs.title: 异常一览
docs.text:
异常 状态码 典型触发场景 TargetObjectAlreadyExist 409 创建时违反唯一约束；自定义更新逻辑中也可主动抛出 PydanticValidationException 422 Pydantic 或 Tortoise 的 ValidationError ImproperlyConfigured 500 配置项类型不合法（如 INSTALLED_APPS 不是列表） TooManyRequest 429 验证码错误次数超限（如注册时的 confirmations 重试过多）

TargetObjectAlreadyExist、PydanticValidationException 与 TooManyRequest 设置了 quiet = True，Sanic 不会把对应请求记为错误日志。

docs.title: 异常在 ViewSet 中的转换
docs.text:
GenericAPIView.as_view() 包裹视图方法，并做以下转换：

原始异常 转换结果 pydantic.ValidationError PydanticValidationException → 422 tortoise.exceptions.ValidationError PydanticValidationException → 422 tortoise.exceptions.IntegrityError CreateModelMixin.perform_create() 转为 TargetObjectAlreadyExist → 409

UpdateModelMixin.perform_update() 本身不捕获 IntegrityError；需要把唯一约束冲突转成 409 时，应在子类（参考 UserViewSet.perform_update）中捕获并抛出 TargetObjectAlreadyExist。

NotFound、Forbidden、BadRequest、MethodNotAllowed 等 Sanic 内置异常保持原状态码，不做包装。

响应体由 Sanic 的 JSONRenderer 生成：

{
  "description": "Unprocessable Entity",
  "status": 422,
  "message": "..."
}

docs.title: 异常类
docs.text:
options: heading_level: 4 members: false show_source: false inherited_members: false

options: heading_level: 4 members: false show_source: false inherited_members: false

ImproperlyConfigured 主要在 LazySettings 初始化时抛出：ALLOWED_HOSTS、INSTALLED_APPS、TEMPLATE_DIRS、LOCALE_PATHS、SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS 必须是列表或元组。

docs.title: API 参考：Filters
docs.text:
过滤器负责把查询参数转换成 Tortoise 的 Q 表达式或 filter() 调用。ListModelMixin.list() 会按 filter_class 的顺序依次执行。使用说明见 过滤。

from srf.filters import (
    JsonLogicFilter,
    OrderingFactory,
    QueryParamFilter,
    SearchFilter,
)

docs.title: 默认过滤器与参数
docs.text:
settings.DEFAULT_FILTERS 的顺序是 SearchFilter、JsonLogicFilter、QueryParamFilter、OrderingFactory，因此以下参数可以同时使用：

参数 过滤器 作用 search SearchFilter 多字段模糊搜索 filter JsonLogicFilter JSON Logic 表达式 ordering OrderingFactory 排序 任意 filter_fields 中的键 QueryParamFilter 精确匹配

字段白名单来自 ViewSet 的类属性：

from srf.views import BaseViewSet


class BookViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    search_fields = ["title", "author"]
    # 别名 -> ORM 字段
    filter_fields = {"published": "is_published", "author_id": "author__id"}
    ordering_fields = ["create_time", "title"]

列表会被当作“字段名即参数名”，字典则用于把外部参数名映射到内部 ORM 字段。

docs.title: 过滤器类
docs.text:
四个内置过滤器都继承 BaseFilter，通过类属性声明各自需要的白名单字段。

子类必须设置 cls_fields（取值为 ViewSet 上保存字段白名单的属性名），否则在类定义阶段就会抛出 TypeError。filter_fields 在实例化时被归一化为 {字段: ORM 字段} 的字典。

?search=alice admin 的语义：

  • 按空白切分成多个关键词；
  • 每个关键词在所有字段之间用 OR 匹配（__icontains）；
  • 多个关键词之间用 AND 组合。

?filter= 接收一段 JSON Logic 表达式，支持的操作符：

操作符 含义 生成的查询 == 等于 field=value != / ! 不等于 NOT field=value > 大于 field__gt >= 大于等于 field__gte < 小于 field__lt <= 小于等于 field__lte in 属于 field__in not in 不属于 NOT field__in like 包含 field__icontains

组合规则：

  • and / or 的参数是__表达式数组__；
  • not 的参数是单个表达式；
  • 字段必须出现在 filter_fields 中，否则该条件被忽略；
  • JSON 无法解析时返回 400 Bad Request。
# ?filter=<urlencoded JSON>
{
    "and": [
        {"==": [{"var": "published"}, True]},
        {"like": [{"var": "title"}, "python"]},
    ]
}

参数名必须与 filter_fields 的键完全一致：

  • 单值：?published=true → 精确匹配；
  • 重复参数：?id=1&id=2 → id__in=[1, 2]。

不在白名单中的参数会被忽略，不会报错。

?ordering=-create_time,title：逗号分隔，前缀 - 表示倒序。未出现在 ordering_fields 中的字段会被忽略；所有字段都无效时保持默认顺序。

docs.title: API 参考：HTTP Status
docs.text:
HTTPStatus 是 IntEnum，既提供可读的常量名，也能直接作为整数传给 Sanic。写 ViewSet 返回值时用它代替裸数字。使用说明见 状态码。

from sanic.response import JSONResponse

from srf.views.http_status import HTTPStatus


async def handler(request):
    return JSONResponse({"ok": True}, status=HTTPStatus.HTTP_201_CREATED)

docs.title: 区间判断函数
docs.text:
这些函数接收整数（或 HTTPStatus 成员）并返回布尔值：

函数 区间 is_informational 100 – 199 is_success 200 – 299 is_redirect 300 – 399 is_client_error 400 – 499 is_server_error 500 – 599

非标准状态码

枚举中也包含 HTTP_306_RESERVED、HTTP_509_BANDWIDTH_LIMIT_EXCEEDED 等非 RFC 标准或已弃用的状态码，保留它们只是为了命名完整性。

docs.title: API 参考：Pagination
docs.text:
分页行为由 ViewSet 的 pagination_class 决定，默认使用 PageNumberPagination。使用说明见 分页。

from srf.paginator import PageNumberPagination
from srf.views import BaseViewSet


class BookViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    queryset = Book.all()  # Tortoise QuerySet
    schema = BookSchema  # Pydantic 模型
    pagination_class = PageNumberPagination

docs.title: 响应结构
docs.text:
list() 返回的对象固定包含四个字段：

{
  "count": 42,
  "next": true,
  "previous": false,
  "results": [{ "id": 1, "title": "..." }]
}

与 DRF 的差异

next / previous 是布尔值，不是下一页/上一页的 URL。前端需要自己拼装页码。

docs.title: 查询参数
docs.text:
参数 默认值 规则 page 1 非整数或小于 1 时回退/夹到 1 page_size 10 非整数时回退为 10，小于 1 时夹到 1，上限为 MAX_PAGE_SIZE（默认 100）
  • 页码超出总页数时返回空 results，count 仍是总记录数。
  • page_size 的上限由类属性 MAX_PAGE_SIZE 控制，子类可以覆盖；构造函数也会把 page / page_size 夹到合法范围。
  • 参数名分别由 PAGE_QUERY_PARAM / PAGE_SIZE_QUERY_PARAM 控制。

docs.title: 分页器 API
docs.text:

自定义分页器应继承 BasePagination 并实现 from_queryset()、paginate()、num_pages()。

options: heading_level: 4 members: - init - MAX_PAGE_SIZE - PAGE_QUERY_PARAM - PAGE_SIZE_QUERY_PARAM - from_queryset - paginate - to_dict - num_pages show_source: false inherited_members: false

options: heading_level: 4 members: true show_source: false inherited_members: false

PaginationResult 的字段对应响应中的四个键。

options: heading_level: 4 show_source: false

serialize_page() 使用按 Schema 缓存的 TypeAdapter(list[schema])，适合在自定义分页器中复用。

docs.title: API 参考：Permissions
docs.text:
权限类在每次请求进入视图方法之前执行。使用说明见 权限 与 接口权限。

from srf.permission import IsAuthenticated, SuperuserOnly

docs.title: 权限契约
docs.text:
权限类的方法以静态方法形式定义，框架直接通过类调用，不会实例化：

from sanic import Request


class IsOwner:
    @staticmethod
    def has_permission(request: Request, view=None) -> bool:
        return getattr(request.ctx, "user", None) is not None

    @staticmethod
    def has_object_permission(request: Request, view=None, obj=None) -> bool:
        user = getattr(request.ctx, "user", None)
        return user is not None and obj.user_id == user.id
  • 同步与异步（async def）方法都支持，框架会自动 await 协程结果。
  • 方法返回假值时抛出 403 Forbidden。
  • 因为是按类调用，不能在权限类里依赖 __init__ 保存的实例状态；需要跨方法共享的数据请放在类属性或 request.ctx 上。

对象级权限的触发时机

has_object_permission() 只在 get_object() 中被调用，因此只对 retrieve / update / destroy 生效。list 不会逐条检查对象权限，需要在 get_queryset() 中按用户过滤；create 也不做对象级检查。

docs.title: 在 ViewSet 中使用
docs.text:
from your_py import IsOwner
from srf.views import BaseViewSet


class ProfileViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    queryset = User.all()
    schema = UserSchema
    permission_classes = (IsOwner,)

docs.title: 内置权限类
docs.text:
类 has_permission 行为 AllowAny 始终允许（默认权限） IsAuthenticated request.ctx.user 存在且 is_active 为真 SafeMethodOnly 只允许安全方法：GET / HEAD / OPTIONS SuperuserOnly request.ctx.user 存在且 is_superuser 为真

未声明 permission_classes 时使用 settings.DEFAULT_PERMISSION_CLASSES，默认值为 (AllowAny,)。

permission_classes 可以是任意可迭代对象；每个元素都需要提供 has_permission(request, view)，需要对象级权限时再提供 has_object_permission(request, view, obj)。

docs.title: API 参考：Routing
docs.text:
路由层只有一个公开类 SanicRouter：把 ViewSet 拆成集合路由、详情路由和 @action 路由，再注册到 Sanic 应用或 Blueprint。使用说明见 路由。

from srf.route import SanicRouter

router = SanicRouter(app, prefix="/api/v1")
router.register("books", BookViewSet)

options: heading_level: 3 members: - init - register show_source: false inherited_members: false

docs.title: 注册结果
docs.text:
register(path, view_cls, name=None) 只会为类中实际存在的视图方法注册路由：

URL HTTP 视图方法 路由名 {prefix}/{path} GET list {name}-list {prefix}/{path} HEAD list {name}-list {prefix}/{path} POST create {name}-list {prefix}/{path}/<pk> GET retrieve {name}-detail {prefix}/{path}/<pk> HEAD retrieve {name}-detail {prefix}/{path}/<pk> PUT update {name}-detail {prefix}/{path}/<pk> PATCH update {name}-detail {prefix}/{path}/<pk> DELETE destroy {name}-detail {prefix}/{path}/{url_path} action.methods action 装饰的方法 {name}-{url_name} {prefix}/{path}/<pk>/{url_path} action.methods detail=True 的 action {name}-{url_name}
  • name 默认等于 path。
  • 若 ViewSet 没有定义 list，就不会创建集合路由；详情路由同理。
  • GET 路由同时支持 HEAD，并复用同一个 list / retrieve 方法。
  • 只读 ViewSet 只会生成 list / retrieve 对应的路由（含 HEAD）。

docs.title: @action 的发现规则
docs.text:
register() 用 inspect.getmembers() 扫描视图类（包括继承来的方法），凡是带有 extra_info 属性的方法都会注册为独立路由。extra_info 由 action 写入：

参数 默认值 作用 detail False 为 True 时 URL 中带 <pk> methods ("GET",) 该 action 接受的 HTTP 方法 url_path "/{函数名}" 追加在集合/详情路径之后 url_name 函数名 用于生成路由名 {name}-{url_name}

前缀规范化

prefix="api/v1/" 会被规范化为 /api/v1，path 两端的 / 会被去掉。因此 SanicRouter(app, prefix="api/v1").register("/books/", BookViewSet) 得到的集合地址是 /api/v1/books。

重名路由

SanicRouter 不检查路由名冲突。两个 ViewSet 使用同一个 name，或两个 action 使用同一个 url_name 时，需要自行保证唯一，否则 Sanic 会报重复路由名。

docs.title: API 参考：Views
docs.text:
视图层是 SRF 的请求处理核心。GenericAPIView 负责动作分发、Schema 校验、权限、过滤与分页，几个 CRUD Mixin 组合成可直接使用的 ViewSet。机制说明与完整示例见 ViewSet 与 动作与装饰器。

from srf.views import BaseViewSet, GenericAPIView, ReadOnlyModelViewSet, action

docs.title: 动作分发
docs.text:
as_view(actions) 把 HTTP 方法映射到视图方法。通常由 SanicRouter.register() 自动构建映射；手动调用 app.add_route() 时才需要自己传入：

from sanic import Sanic

from srf.views import BaseViewSet

app = Sanic("demo")


class BookViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    queryset = Book.all()  # Tortoise QuerySet
    schema = BookSchema  # Pydantic 模型


app.add_route(
    BookViewSet.as_view({"get": "list", "post": "create"}),
    "/books",
)

actions 的键是小写 HTTP 方法，值是要调用的方法名。未在映射中出现的方法不会注册到路由；运行期取不到对应方法时抛出 405 Method Not Allowed。

PUT 与 PATCH

当前 put 和 patch 都映射到 update，且 update 按完整 Schema 校验请求体。两者语义上的区分（完整更新 / 部分更新）尚未实现。

docs.title: 视图基类
docs.text:
GenericAPIView 是所有视图的公共基类；另外三个组合类只是把 CRUD Mixin 预先拼好。

三个组合类的差异：

类 提供的动作 BaseViewSet create / list / retrieve / update / destroy ReadOnlyModelViewSet list / retrieve CreateAndReadOnlyModelViewSet create / list / retrieve

docs.title: CRUD Mixins
docs.text:
每个 Mixin 只提供一个动作，需要更细粒度的组合时可以直接继承。

create 的行为：

  • 请求体不是 JSON 时返回 400。
  • 使用 schema 以 strict=True 校验输入，随后调用 perform_create()。
  • 输出使用同一个 Schema 序列化，返回 201。
  • 数据库唯一约束冲突（IntegrityError）转换为 409 TargetObjectAlreadyExist。

查询对象时先做主键类型归一化，再执行对象级权限检查；对象不存在返回 404。

perform_update() 只写入请求中显式提供的字段（exclude_unset=True），并跳过主键字段。

删除成功后返回 204 No Content。

list 的执行顺序是：get_queryset() → filter_queryset() → pagination_class.from_queryset() → paginate()。响应结构见 分页。

docs.title: 动作装饰器
docs.text:
action 把 ViewSet 中的普通方法声明为一个独立接口，SanicRouter 会自动发现并注册。

validate_request 用于装饰函数式视图（例如 srf.auth 中的 register、verify_email）。ViewSet 的请求校验由 as_view() 统一处理，不需要再叠加这个装饰器。

docs.title: 导出清单
docs.text:
from srf.views import ... 可用以下名字：

from srf.views import (
    BaseViewSet,
    CreateAndReadOnlyModelViewSet,
    CreateModelMixin,
    DestroyModelMixin,
    GenericAPIView,
    ListModelMixin,
    ModelMixin,
    ReadOnlyModelViewSet,
    RetrieveModelMixin,
    UpdateModelMixin,
    action,
)

validate_request 不在导出清单中，需从 srf.views.decorators 导入。

docs.title: 快速开始
docs.text: 本指南将带您从零开始创建第一个基于 Sanic RESTful framework 的项目。

docs.title: 环境要求
docs.text:
在开始之前，请确保您的环境满足以下要求：

  • Python: 3.11 或更高版本
  • pip: Python 包管理工具
  • 数据库: PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQLite 等（本教程使用 SQLite）

docs.title: 1. 创建项目目录
docs.text:
mkdir bookstore
cd bookstore

docs.title: 2. 创建虚拟环境
docs.text:
推荐使用 conda 创建独立的 Python 环境：

# 创建名为 srf 的虚拟环境
conda create -n srf python=3.11

# 激活虚拟环境
conda activate srf

或使用 UV：

uv init

docs.title: 3. 安装 SRF
docs.text:
pip install sanic-restful-framework
# 或者
uv add sanic-restful-framework

docs.title: 4. 核对运行依赖
docs.text:
安装 SRF 时会自动安装核心依赖，包括 Sanic >=25.0.0,<26、 Tortoise ORM >=1.1.8,<2、Pydantic >=2.6.1,<3、sanic-jwt、redis 和 bcrypt。

sanic-cors 和 python-dotenv 是可选依赖，分别用于 CORS 集成和从 .env 文件加载配置；只有使用相应示例时才需要单独安装。

docs.title: 创建第一个项目
docs.text: 让我们创建一个简单的图书管理 API。

docs.title: 步骤 1：创建应用文件
docs.text:
创建 app.py 文件：

from sanic import Sanic
from tortoise.contrib.sanic import register_tortoise
from srf.config import settings

# 创建 Sanic 应用
app = Sanic("BookStore")

# 配置 SRF
settings.set_app(app)

# 数据库配置
register_tortoise(
    app,
    db_url="sqlite://db.sqlite3",
    modules={"models": ["models"]},
    generate_schemas=True,
)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(host="0.0.0.0", port=8000, debug=True)

docs.title: 步骤 2：定义数据模型
docs.text:
创建 models.py 文件：

from tortoise import fields
from tortoise.models import Model


class Book(Model):
    """图书模型"""

    id = fields.IntField(pk=True)
    title = fields.CharField(max_length=200)
    author = fields.CharField(max_length=100)
    price = fields.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2)
    stock = fields.IntField(default=0)

    class Meta:
        table = "books"

docs.title: 步骤 3：定义 Schema
docs.text:
创建 schemas.py 文件：

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, ConfigDict
from typing import Optional


class BookSchemaWriter(BaseModel):
    """图书写入 Schema（用于创建和更新）"""

    title: str = Field(..., max_length=200)
    author: str = Field(..., max_length=100)
    price: float = Field(..., gt=0)
    stock: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)


class BookSchemaReader(BaseModel):
    """图书读取 Schema（用于序列化）"""

    id: int
    title: str
    author: str
    price: float
    stock: int

    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

docs.title: 步骤 4：创建 ViewSet
docs.text:
创建 viewsets.py 文件：

from srf.views import BaseViewSet
from srf.views.decorators import action
from sanic.response import json
from models import Book
from schemas import BookSchemaWriter, BookSchemaReader


class BookViewSet(BaseViewSet):
    """图书 ViewSet"""

    search_fields = ["title", "author"]
    # search_fields、filter_fields 都可以用别名映射；字典可将查询参数名映射到 ORM 字段
    filter_fields = {"author": "author"}

    @property
    def queryset(self):
        return Book.all()

    def get_schema(self):
        # as_view 会设置 self.action；此处按 ViewSet 操作名区分读写 Schema。
        if self.action in ("list", "retrieve"):
            return BookSchemaReader
        return BookSchemaWriter

    @action(methods=["get"], detail=False, url_path="search")
    async def search_books(self, request):
        """搜索图书"""
        keyword = request.args.get("q", "")
        books = await Book.filter(title__icontains=keyword)
        data = [BookSchemaReader.model_validate(b).model_dump() for b in books]
        return json({"results": data})

docs.title: 步骤 5：注册路由
docs.text:
在 app.py 顶部补充导入，然后在 register_tortoise(...) 之后注册 ViewSet：

from srf.route import SanicRouter
from viewsets import BookViewSet

router = SanicRouter(app, prefix="api")
router.register("books", BookViewSet, name="books")

SanicRouter 会为 ViewSet 自动生成集合路由（/api/books）和详情路由 （/api/books/<pk>），并发现 @action 方法。

docs.title: 步骤 6：运行应用
docs.text:
python app.py

您应该看到类似以下的输出：

[2026-02-07 10:00:00 +0800] [12345] [INFO] Goin' Fast @ http://0.0.0.0:8000
[2026-02-07 10:00:00 +0800] [12345] [INFO] Starting worker [12345]

docs.title: 测试 API
docs.text: 现在您的 API 已经运行，让我们测试一下！

docs.title: 1. 创建图书
docs.text:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/books \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "title": "Python 编程",
    "author": "张三",
    "price": 89.00,
    "stock": 50
  }'

响应：

{
  "id": 1,
  "title": "Python 编程",
  "author": "张三",
  "price": 89.00,
  "stock": 50
}

docs.title: 2. 获取图书列表
docs.text:
curl http://localhost:8000/api/books

响应：

{
  "count": 1,
  "next": false,
  "previous": false,
  "results": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "title": "Python 编程",
      "author": "张三",
      "price": 89.00,
      "stock": 50
    }
  ]
}

docs.title: 3. 获取单本图书
docs.text:
curl http://localhost:8000/api/books/1

响应体是创建接口返回的同一个图书对象。

docs.title: 4. 更新图书
docs.text:
curl -X PUT http://localhost:8000/api/books/1 \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "title": "Python 编程（第2版）",
    "author": "张三",
    "price": 99.00,
    "stock": 50
  }'

响应：

{
  "id": 1,
  "title": "Python 编程（第2版）",
  "author": "张三",
  "price": 99.00,
  "stock": 50
}

docs.title: 5. 按字段过滤
docs.text:
filter_fields 中声明的参数可以直接用于精确过滤：

curl "http://localhost:8000/api/books?author=张三"

响应结构与列表接口相同，results 中只包含匹配的记录。

docs.title: 6. 分页
docs.text:
# 获取第1页，每页10条
curl "http://localhost:8000/api/books?page=1&page_size=10"

响应格式同上：count 为总数，results 为当前页数据。

docs.title: 7. 使用自定义操作
docs.text:
# 自定义 action 使用 q 参数搜索标题
curl "http://localhost:8000/api/books/search?q=Python"

响应：

{
  "results": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "title": "Python 编程（第2版）",
      "author": "张三",
      "price": 99.00,
      "stock": 50
    }
  ]
}

docs.title: 8. 删除图书
docs.text:
curl -i -X DELETE http://localhost:8000/api/books/1

响应：204 No Content（无响应体）。

docs.title: 完整的项目结构
docs.text:
bookstore/
├── app.py                 # 应用入口
├── models.py              # 数据模型
├── schemas.py             # Pydantic Schemas
├── viewsets.py            # ViewSets
└── db.sqlite3             # 数据库文件（自动生成）

docs.title: 下一步
docs.text:
恭喜！您已经成功创建了第一个 SRF 项目。接下来可以：

  1. 添加认证：查看 认证 章节，为您的 API 添加 JWT 认证
  2. 添加权限控制：阅读 权限 章节，限制用户访问
  3. 深入了解 ViewSet：学习 视图 的高级用法
  4. 配置项目：查看 项目设置 了解更多配置选项

docs.title: 如何修改数据库？
docs.text:
修改 register_tortoise 中的 db_url：

# PostgreSQL
db_url = "postgres://user:password@localhost:5432/dbname"

# MySQL
db_url = "mysql://user:password@localhost:3306/dbname"

# SQLite
db_url = "sqlite://db.sqlite3"

docs.title: 如何禁用自动生成表结构？
docs.text:
设置 generate_schemas=False：

register_tortoise(
    app,
    db_url="sqlite://db.sqlite3",
    modules={"models": ["models"]},
    generate_schemas=False,  # 禁用自动生成
)

docs.title: 如何修改端口？
docs.text:
修改 app.run() 的参数：

app.run(host="0.0.0.0", port=9000, debug=True)

docs.title: 如何启用 CORS？
docs.text:
安装并配置 sanic-cors：

pip install sanic-cors

from sanic_cors import CORS

app = Sanic("BookStore")
CORS(app)

docs.title: 项目设置
docs.text: 本章介绍如何正确设置和配置一个 SRF 项目，包括项目结构、配置管理、数据库设置等。

docs.title: 推荐的项目结构
docs.text:
假定一个 SRF 项目结构如下：

myproject/
├── app.py                      # 应用入口
├── config.py                   # 配置文件
├── requirements.txt            # 依赖列表
├── .env                        # 环境变量
├── models/                     # 数据模型
│   ├── __init__.py
│   ├── product.py
│   ├── order.py
│   └── category.py
├── schemas/                    # Pydantic Schemas
│   ├── __init__.py
│   ├── product.py
│   ├── order.py
│   └── category.py
├── viewsets/                   # ViewSets
│   ├── __init__.py
│   ├── product.py
│   ├── order.py
│   └── category.py
├── routes.py                   # 路由配置
├── permissions.py              # 自定义权限类
├── filters.py                  # 自定义过滤器
├── middleware.py               # 自定义中间件
├── utils/                      # 工具函数
│   ├── __init__.py
│   ├── helpers.py
│   └── validators.py
└── tests/                      # 测试
    ├── __init__.py
    ├── test_products.py
    └── test_orders.py

docs.title: 环境变量
docs.text:
创建 .env 文件来存储敏感信息：

# .env
SECRET_KEY=your-secret-key-here
DATABASE_URL=sqlite://db.sqlite3
REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379/0

# JWT 配置
JWT_SECRET=your-jwt-secret
# 访问/刷新令牌有效期在 srf.config.settings 中以 timedelta 定义，不通过环境变量读取

# 邮件配置（srf.tools.email 实际读取的名称）
FROM_EMAIL=your-email@gmail.com
SMTP_SERVER=smtp.gmail.com
SMTP_PORT=587
PASSWORD=your-password

docs.title: 配置文件
docs.text:
创建 config.py 来管理配置：

import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv

# 加载环境变量
load_dotenv()

class Config:
    """基础配置"""
    SECRET_KEY = os.getenv("SECRET_KEY", "your-secret-key")
    DATABASE_URL = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL", "sqlite://db.sqlite3")
    REDIS_URL = os.getenv("REDIS_URL", "redis://localhost:6379/0")

    # JWT 配置
    JWT_SECRET = os.getenv("JWT_SECRET", SECRET_KEY)
    # JWT_ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRES 在 srf.config.settings 中以 timedelta 定义；
    # register_jwt_urls 会把它换算成秒并传给 sanic-jwt

    # 邮件：send_email 读取 settings.EMAIL_CONFIG；可用 app.config.EMAIL_CONFIG 覆盖，
    # 默认值来自 FROM_EMAIL/SMTP_SERVER/SMTP_PORT/PASSWORD 环境变量

    # 社交登录（键名大写，与 SOCIAL_CONFIG 一致）
    SOCIAL_CONFIG = {
        "github": {...}
    }

    # CORS 配置
    CORS_ORIGINS = ["http://localhost:3000", "http://localhost:8080"]

class DevelopmentConfig(Config):
    """开发环境配置"""
    DEBUG = True
    DATABASE_URL = "sqlite://db_dev.sqlite3"

class ProductionConfig(Config):
    """生产环境配置"""
    DEBUG = False
    DATABASE_URL = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")

class TestConfig(Config):
    """测试环境配置"""
    TESTING = True
    DATABASE_URL = "sqlite://:memory:"

# 根据环境变量选择配置
config_map = {
    "development": DevelopmentConfig,
    "production": ProductionConfig,
    "test": TestConfig,
}

env = os.getenv("ENVIRONMENT", "development")
config = config_map[env]

python-dotenv 不属于 SRF 的依赖；如需从 .env 文件加载配置，请额外安装：

pip install python-dotenv

docs.title: 应用配置
docs.text:
在 app.py 中应用配置：

from sanic import Sanic
from tortoise.contrib.sanic import register_tortoise
from srf.config import settings
from config import config

app = Sanic("MyApp")

# 应用配置到 Sanic
app.config.update_config(config)

# 配置 SRF
settings.set_app(app)

# 配置数据库
register_tortoise(
    app,
    db_url=config.DATABASE_URL,
    modules={"models": ["models"]},
    generate_schemas=True,
)

docs.title: Tortoise ORM 配置
docs.text: SRF 使用 Tortoise ORM 1.1.8 及以上版本作为默认 ORM 框架。

docs.title: 基本配置
docs.text:
register_tortoise(
    app,
    db_url="sqlite://db.sqlite3",
    modules={"models": ["models"]},
    generate_schemas=True,
)

docs.title: PostgreSQL 配置
docs.text:
需要额外安装 PostgreSQL 驱动：pip install asyncpg。

register_tortoise(
    app,
    db_url="postgres://user:password@localhost:5432/dbname",
    modules={"models": ["models"]},
    generate_schemas=True,
)

docs.title: MySQL 配置
docs.text:
需要额外安装 MySQL 驱动：pip install asyncmy。

register_tortoise(
    app,
    db_url="mysql://user:password@localhost:3306/dbname",
    modules={"models": ["models"]},
    generate_schemas=True,
